rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: The Amplitude MCP server enables teams to analyze product data, experiments, and user behavior through conversational AI by providing direct access to Amplitude analytics, dashboards, experiments, and feature flags via natural language queries. Built as a remote server supporting OAuth authentication, it offers 20+ tools covering comprehensive analytics operations including chart querying, experiment analysis, cohort management, session replay search, and content discovery across dashboards and notebooks. The implementation maintains existing Amplitude user permissions and access controls while enabling AI-powered data analysis workflows, making it particularly useful for product teams who want to quickly explore metrics, analyze A/B test results, and investigate user behavior patterns without navigating the Amplitude interface directly.
